alarm_id.description: Unique identifier for a normalized alarm in the assurance system

correlation_id.description: Identifier for a correlated alarm group or incident

remediation_run_id.description: Identifier for an auto-remediation or workflow execution run

validation_session_id.description: Identifier for a QA validation session against a set of alarms or incidents

network_element_ref.description: Reference to a network element where alarms originated

ne_type.description: Network element type (e.g., eNodeB, gNodeB, Router)

ne_id.description: Unique identifier of the network element in inventory

alarm_signature.description: Signature used for deduplication and correlation of alarms

original_alarm_id.description: Alarm identifier in the source system
